claim: To schedule an exam through the AWS Certification Account, a candidate signs in to aws.training, opens the account, selects Schedule New Exam, chooses the Pearson VUE scheduling button, and is redirected to the test delivery provider's scheduling page.

evidence.quote: To schedule an AWS Certification exam through your AWS Certification Account, complete the following steps:
Select the Go to your Account button, followed by the Schedule New Exam button.
Find the exam you wish to take, and then select Schedule with Pearson VUE.

To register for an exam, sign in to aws.training and click Certification in the top navigation. Next, click the AWS Certification Account button, followed by Schedule New Exam. Find the exam you wish to take and click the Schedule at Pearson VUE button. You will then be redirected to the test delivery provider’s scheduling page, where you will complete your exam registration.

note: The FAQ (fetched 2026-10-05) labels the buttons 'AWS Certification Account' and 'Schedule at Pearson VUE'; the before-testing policy page (fetched 2026-10-09) labels them 'Go to your Account' and 'Schedule with Pearson VUE'. The claim names only what both pages share. d00-019: Day 1 booking step. Console click paths change often, so volatility is frequently-changing. Repaired 2026-10-11 after an unsure currency vote.
